purpose: Teach: 東日本/東亜/堺/生き残り/脳裏/紡/転生/テクスト

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、東日本大震災時の不明者再捜査を、警察、進められますね
lines.en: The police are conducting a thorough re-investigation into the missing persons from the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake, aren't they?
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful delivery. Slight pause before each clause. Respectful tone when naming the disaster. Suggests Ren is processing the weight of what he's asking about.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、東亜地域の国際捜査連携もされますね
lines.en: Yes, and the police are also coordinating with international partners across East Asia.
lines.style: Calm, professional confirmation. Even pace. Takeda nods through this—he's briefed, he's solid. Not defensive, just factual and steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、堺市の事案を、警察、地元署と連携されますね
lines.en: And in this case, the police are working closely with the local precinct in Sakai, correct?
lines.style: Quiet inquiry, not interrogation. Ren is checking his understanding. Slight lift at the end—genuine question, not rhetorical.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者ご家族の生き残りの方々の保護を、警察、慎重におこなわれますね
lines.en: They are. The police are also being very careful about how they handle and support the survivors and families of the victims.
lines.style: Slower tempo here, words chosen with visible care. Takeda's voice carries weight—this matters. Not somber, but serious and grounded.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、目撃者の脳裏に残る情景を、警察、丁寧に聴かれますね
lines.en: And the police are taking time to listen carefully to what witnesses remember, what lingers in their minds about what they saw.
lines.style: Gentle but precise. Ren's words almost float—he's thinking about the weight of those memories. Respectful pause before 'what they saw.'

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査の糸を紡ぐ、つまり紡ぐような地道な捜査をされますね
lines.en: Exactly. The police are doing painstaking work—you could say they're weaving the threads of the investigation together, piece by piece.
lines.style: Takeda leans into the metaphor. Slower, deliberate cadence. Each phrase lands. He's explaining something he believes in, not just delivering information.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、宗教団体の転生信仰関連の捜査を、警察、慎重におこなわれますね
lines.en: And the police are being careful with their investigation into the religious group's beliefs around reincarnation that may be connected to the case.
lines.style: Restrained, precise. Ren is choosing words carefully—he's not dismissing belief, but he's noting a connection. Clinical but not cold.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、押収物のテクスト、つまり文書の解読を、警察、専門家に依頼されますね
lines.en: Right. The police have also asked specialists to help decrypt and interpret the documents they seized from the group.
lines.style: Businesslike but not rushed. Takeda's voice carries confidence in the process. Matter-of-fact, but the word 'specialists' carries trust.
